scope: UNSIGNED, LOCAL, NON-EXECUTABLE producer artifacts for wallet decoder replay. Nothing was signed, sent or simulated by a wallet; the local_chain_execution records are of an anvil chain with no fork. Hosted launch support is disabled and no live instance pin exists.

contract.summary_keccak256: keccak256(utf8(JSON.stringify(summary without summary_keccak256))), key order exactly as in owner_summary
contract.artifact_integrity: keccak256(utf8(body)); bytes = utf8 length of body; body is canonical JSON (re-serialising the parsed body reproduces it)
contract.version_discriminator: pin.feeModel inside the sealed body and fields.instance.fee_model in the summary, together with the pin's runtime and ABI hashes; never inferred from an address or event
contract.decay_rate_x32: canonical decimal string, 0 to 18446744073709551615 (uint64 Q32.32 ticks per second); 0 is a flat fee at initialFee
contract.half_life_seconds: display only: floor(HALF_LIFE_X32_E30 * 10^6 / (rate * 10^30)) microseconds as S.uuuuuu; null for rate 0
contract.saturation_elapsed_seconds: floor(MAX_DECAY_PRODUCT / rate) as a decimal string; from the next elapsed second the fee is exactly final_fee; null for rate 0; not a schedule end
contract.fixed_base_duration_v1_policy: No preview or create is produced for this model (unsupported_fee_model). Reads, LaunchCreated decoding and claims keep the 43d6628 ABI and math unchanged.

statements: Zero initial bid: the pool starts with no native ETH. Until someone buys, selling the launch token fills nothing.
Buyer-funded quote reserve: the only native ETH in the pool is what buyers pay in. Sells can withdraw only that.

Permanent principal lock: of the total supply of 1000000000000000000000000000 raw units, 999999999999999999999999422 go into one position that nobody, including you, can withdraw, rebalance, migrate or refund, and the remainder of 578, too small to pay for one more unit of liquidity, is minted to address(0), where nobody can ever spend it. Quote that buyers pay in is locked in the position too.

Creator fee: 50.0000% at trading start 2027-01-15T08:30:22.000Z. The excess over 0.3000% halves about every 86400.000001 s, so the fee approaches 0.3000%, a long-run floor and not an end date: it reaches 0.3000% exactly only by rounding, or once more than 5529597 s have passed since trading start. The excess over 0.3000% first falls to half or less 86401 s after trading start. The fee is taken on the calculated side of every swap into a separate two-asset fee ledger, never into principal.

Launch ownership: 0x70997970c51812dc3a010c7d01b50e0d17dc79c8 (this account) becomes the launch owner. Only the current owner can claim the fee ledger, and ownership can be transferred. Whoever owns the launch when it claims receives every unclaimed fee, including fees earned before a transfer.

Owner recapture: every fee goes to the launch owner. When the owner, or anyone buying for it, trades, it gets that fee back through its claim: on an exact-input buy at 50.0000% it can end up with the whole pre-fee output, while anyone else making the same trade gets only the net. The fee cannot tell owners, snipers and honest buyers apart.

High early fee: near 50.0000%, a swap can deliver a negligible or zero amount after the fee, and an immediate round trip pays the fee twice plus price impact. A high starting fee is not protection against snipers and does not promise that anyone avoids a loss.

Exact-output gross-up: for a fixed output, the input paid is the pre-fee input times 1 / (1 - fee), about 2.00x at 50.0000%, which grows much faster than the fee itself. Large amounts at high fees revert on overflow. Always set a minimum output or a maximum input.
No exit guarantee: there is no buyer of last resort, no refund and no admin rescue. The price can fall back to the ask.
Quote trust: the quote is native ETH, which Core accounts for itself. No quote token contract is trusted.

Quote trust: quote token 0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff is trusted across all of Core, not just this pool. Core keeps one balance per token, so if this token misreports balances or transfers, every pool, position and fee ledger holding it is exposed, including other launches and ordinary pools on it, and an honest token paired with it can lose that pool's own reserve. A transfer fee, rebase, blocked transfer or callback breaks every pool on it the same way. Pools that do not hold this token, including native ETH and unrelated tokens, keep their own per-token accounting and are not reachable through it.

statements: Withdraws the whole two-asset fee ledger of this launch to 0x90f79bf6eb2c4f870365e785982e1f101e93b906, both assets or neither. It never touches the locked principal.
Only the current launch owner can claim. Ownership is transferable, so the right to claim follows the current owner, not the account that created the launch.
